basic.name: 普通攻击：高压射钉
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害；
在[普通攻击]期间向侧方拖曳摇杆，可以发动垫步射击，调整身位并造成物理伤害，在[普通攻击]第一/第二段后发动时，继续点按 【普通攻击键】 会从[普通攻击]第三/第四段连击继续；
格莉丝在[普通攻击]期间发动[特殊技]、[强化特殊技]、[闪避]、[冲刺攻击]、[闪避反击]时，不会打断[普通攻击]的连击段数。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 attacks, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
While launching Basic Attacks, drag the joystick to move while attacking. This allows Grace to reposition herself and deal Physical DMG. If used after the 1st or 2nd hit of a Basic Attack, pressing [Basic Attack] again resumes the combo from the 3rd or 4th hit of the Basic Attack.
While Grace is launching Basic Attacks, her Basic Attack combo will not be interrupted by her Special Attacks, EX Special Attacks, Dodge, Dash Attacks, or Dodge Counter.

special.name: 特殊技：工程清障
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方投掷一颗手雷，造成电属性伤害；
发动招式时，可以拖曳摇杆，向对应方向调整身位；
消耗[电能]发动时可以闪避敌人的攻击；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Throws a grenade forward, dealing Electric DMG.
During the skill, drag the joystick to reposition in that direction.
When activated via consuming Zap, dodge incoming enemy attacks.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：超规工程清障
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Supercharged Obstruction Removal
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
腾空跃起，并向前方投掷两颗手雷，造成大量电属性伤害；
发动招式时，可以拖曳摇杆，向对应方向调整身位；
若[电能]层数到达上限，会额外投掷一枚[涡流集束手雷]，在爆炸位置生成电磁场，持续牵引敌人，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Leaps into the air and throws two grenades forward, dealing massive Electric DMG.
During the skill, drag the joystick to change directions.
If Zap reaches max stacks, throws an additional Vortex Cluster Grenade, generating an electromagnetic field at the point of detonation that pulls in enemies and deals Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodge.name: 闪避：安全条款
dodge.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodge.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dashAttack.name: 冲刺攻击：突击检查
dashAttack.trigger: 闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dashAttack.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
dashAttack.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方滑铲扫射，造成物理伤害。
dashAttack.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Slide forward while shooting, dealing Physical DMG.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：违章处罚
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对敌人投掷一颗手雷，造成电属性伤害，随后自动发动[普通攻击]第四段；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Throws a grenade at enemies, dealing Electric DMG, then automatically triggers the Basic Attack's 4th hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：协作施工
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向空中抛出三颗手雷，随后扫射将其引爆，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Throws three grenades into the air then strafes to detonate them, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：工程爆破请勿接近
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
丢出一枚特制的手雷，其在空中爆炸后会分裂成四颗更小的手雷，造成大量电属性伤害；
获得8层[电能]和25层[脉冲]（上限25层）；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Throws a custom grenade which explodes in the air and splits into four smaller grenades, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Gains 8 stacks of Zap and 25 stacks of Pulse (max 25 stacks).
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：事故解决方案
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched in the air, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对敌人投掷一颗手雷，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched in the air, press [Switch] to activate:
Throws a grenade at the enemy, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 回避支援：快速风险响应
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
回避敌人的攻击，并触发[极限视域]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：反击电针
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动回旋扫射并投掷手雷，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Unleashes a spinning hail of bullets against enemies in front and throws a grenade, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.text: 格莉丝[普通攻击]或[冲刺攻击]命中敌人并造成物理伤害时，获得一层[电能]（上限8层）；[电能]层数到达上限后，发动[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]时，会消耗所有[电能]，使招式累积的电属性异常积蓄值提升130%。
fields.textEn: When Grace's Basic Attack or Dash Attack hits an enemy and deals Physical DMG, she gains 1 stack of Zap (up to 8 stacks). Upon reaching maximum stacks, using a Special Attack or EX Special Attack will consume all stacks of Zap, increasing the accumulated Electric Anomaly Buildup by 130%.

fields.text:
队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色或其他[异常]角色时触发：
格莉丝[强化特殊技]命中敌人时，目标下次被施加[感电]效果时，受到的[感电]伤害提升18%，最多叠加2层，同一招式内每个敌人最多触发一次效果，[感电]状态结束时效果重置。
fields.textEn:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction, or is an Anomaly character:
When Grace's EX Special Attack hits an enemy, the next time that target is afflicted with Shock, that instance of Shock DMG is increased by 18%, stacking up to 2 times. This effect can trigger on each enemy only once per skill use, and all stacks reset when the Shock state ends.

ex.name: [脉冲]（潜能觉醒）
ex.description:
发动[终结技]时，获得25层[脉冲]（上限25层），获得[电能]时会消耗一层[脉冲]；
消耗[脉冲]获得8层[电能]时，下次投掷手雷时会额外丢出一枚脉冲手雷，并在命中处于以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、冰属性异常状态、风属性异常状态的目标时，触发一次[异放]：额外结算一次原属性异常560%/280%/700%/50%/70%/28%的伤害；
[脉冲]状态下解锁[特殊技：工程清障·循环]。
ex.descriptionEn:
Activating an Ultimate grants 25 stacks of Pulse (max 25 stacks). When gaining Zap, consumes 1 stack of Pulse.
After consuming Pulse to obtain 8 stacks of Zap, the next grenade throw includes an additional Pulse Grenade. If it hits an enemy suffering Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers Abloom: deals an additional instance of DMG equal to 560%/280%/700%/50%/70%/28% of the original Anomaly's DMG.
While in the Pulse state, Special Attack: Obstruction Removal - Cycle is unlocked.

ex.name: 特殊技：工程清障·循环（潜能觉醒）
ex.nameEn: Special Attack: Obstruction Removal - Cycle (Potential Awakening)
ex.description:
[脉冲]状态下长按 【特殊技键】 发动：
招式期间持续向前方投掷手雷，造成电属性伤害，每次投掷手雷获得一层[电能]；
发动招式时，可以拖曳摇杆，向对应方向调整身位，并可以闪避敌人的攻击；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
While in the Pulse state, hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Repeatedly hurls grenades forward during the skill, dealing Electric DMG and granting 1 Zap stack each time grenades are thrown.
During the skill, tilt the joystick to reposition and dodge enemy attacks.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

fields.triggerEn: Activating an Ultimate grants 25 stacks of Pulse (max 25 stacks). When gaining Zap, consumes 1 stack of Pulse.
fields.description:
发动[终结技]时，获得25层[脉冲]（上限25层），获得[电能]时会消耗一层[脉冲]；
消耗[脉冲]获得8层[电能]时，下次投掷手雷时会额外丢出一枚脉冲手雷，并在命中处于以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、冰属性异常状态、风属性异常状态的目标时，触发一次[异放]：额外结算一次原属性异常560%/280%/700%/50%/70%/28%的伤害；
[脉冲]状态下解锁[特殊技：工程清障·循环]。
fields.descriptionEn:
Activating an Ultimate grants 25 stacks of Pulse (max 25 stacks). When gaining Zap, consumes 1 stack of Pulse.
After consuming Pulse to obtain 8 stacks of Zap, the next grenade throw includes an additional Pulse Grenade. If it hits an enemy suffering Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers Abloom: deals an additional instance of DMG equal to 560%/280%/700%/50%/70%/28% of the original Anomaly's DMG.
While in the Pulse state, Special Attack: Obstruction Removal - Cycle is unlocked.

fields.name: 特殊技：工程清障·循环（潜能觉醒）
fields.nameEn: Special Attack: Obstruction Removal - Cycle (Potential Awakening)
fields.trigger: [脉冲]状态下长按 【特殊技键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: While in the Pulse state, hold [Special Attack] to activate:
fields.description:
[脉冲]状态下长按 【特殊技键】 发动：
招式期间持续向前方投掷手雷，造成电属性伤害，每次投掷手雷获得一层[电能]；
发动招式时，可以拖曳摇杆，向对应方向调整身位，并可以闪避敌人的攻击；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
fields.descriptionEn:
While in the Pulse state, hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Repeatedly hurls grenades forward during the skill, dealing Electric DMG and granting 1 Zap stack each time grenades are thrown.
During the skill, tilt the joystick to reposition and dodge enemy attacks.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

fields.name: 闪避：安全条款
fields.trigger: 点按 【闪避键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Dodge] to activate:
fields.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 冲刺攻击：突击检查
fields.trigger: 闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
fields.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方滑铲扫射，造成物理伤害。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Slide forward while shooting, dealing Physical DMG.

fields.name: 闪避反击：违章处罚
fields.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
fields.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对敌人投掷一颗手雷，造成电属性伤害，随后自动发动[普通攻击]第四段；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Throws a grenade at enemies, dealing Electric DMG, then automatically triggers the Basic Attack's 4th hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 连携技：协作施工
fields.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
fields.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
fields.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向空中抛出三颗手雷，随后扫射将其引爆，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Throws three grenades into the air then strafes to detonate them, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 终结技：工程爆破请勿接近
fields.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
fields.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
丢出一枚特制的手雷，其在空中爆炸后会分裂成四颗更小的手雷，造成大量电属性伤害；
获得8层[电能]和25层[脉冲]（上限25层）；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Throws a custom grenade which explodes in the air and splits into four smaller grenades, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Gains 8 stacks of Zap and 25 stacks of Pulse (max 25 stacks).
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 快速支援：事故解决方案
fields.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: When the active character is launched in the air, press [Switch] to activate:
fields.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对敌人投掷一颗手雷，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched in the air, press [Switch] to activate:
Throws a grenade at the enemy, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 回避支援：快速风险响应
fields.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
fields.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
回避敌人的攻击，并触发[极限视域]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 支援突击：反击电针
fields.trigger: 发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
fields.description:
发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动回旋扫射并投掷手雷，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Unleashes a spinning hail of bullets against enemies in front and throws a grenade, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 核心被动：预驱动撞针
fields.trigger: 格莉丝[普通攻击]或[冲刺攻击]命中敌人并造成物理伤害时，获得一层[电能]（上限8层）；[电能]层数到达上限后，发动[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]时，会消耗所有[电能]，使招式累积的电属性异常积蓄值提升130%。
fields.triggerEn: When Grace's Basic Attack or Dash Attack hits an enemy and deals Physical DMG, she gains 1 stack of Zap (up to 8 stacks). Upon reaching maximum stacks, using a Special Attack or EX Special Attack will consume all stacks of Zap, increasing the accumulated Electric Anomaly Buildup by 130%.
fields.description: 格莉丝[普通攻击]或[冲刺攻击]命中敌人并造成物理伤害时，获得一层[电能]（上限8层）；[电能]层数到达上限后，发动[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]时，会消耗所有[电能]，使招式累积的电属性异常积蓄值提升130%。
fields.descriptionEn: When Grace's Basic Attack or Dash Attack hits an enemy and deals Physical DMG, she gains 1 stack of Zap (up to 8 stacks). Upon reaching maximum stacks, using a Special Attack or EX Special Attack will consume all stacks of Zap, increasing the accumulated Electric Anomaly Buildup by 130%.

fields.name: 额外能力：技术支持班组
fields.trigger: 队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色或其他[异常]角色时触发：
fields.triggerEn: When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction, or is an Anomaly character:
fields.description:
队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色或其他[异常]角色时触发：
格莉丝[强化特殊技]命中敌人时，目标下次被施加[感电]效果时，受到的[感电]伤害提升18%，最多叠加2层，同一招式内每个敌人最多触发一次效果，[感电]状态结束时效果重置。
fields.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction, or is an Anomaly character:
When Grace's EX Special Attack hits an enemy, the next time that target is afflicted with Shock, that instance of Shock DMG is increased by 18%, stacking up to 2 times. This effect can trigger on each enemy only once per skill use, and all stacks reset when the Shock state ends.

fields.name: 潜能觉醒：超频工程引擎
fields.trigger: 本阶未单列额外能力文本；技能变化见对应的潜能觉醒变体。
fields.triggerEn: No separate ability text is provided for this rank; see the corresponding awakened skill variants.

fields.trigger: 消耗[电能]时获得[电能强化]状态，造成的电属性伤害提升10%，持续25秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
fields.triggerEn: When consuming Zap, gain Enhanced Zap, increasing Electric DMG by 10% for 25s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
